problems.quote: Note that Kangchenjunga is not in India but on the border; the highest peak entirely within Indian territory is Nanda Devi.
problems.problem: Kangchenjunga (Kanchenjunga) lies on the India–Nepal border, so it is partly in India; it is incorrect to say it is not in India.
problems.correction: Note that Kangchenjunga lies on the India–Nepal border; the highest peak entirely within Indian territory is Nanda Devi.
problems.verifierReason: Original falsely claims Kangchenjunga is not in India; it straddles the border so it is partly in India. Correction accurately states it lies on the border and Nanda Devi is highest entirely within In

problems.quote: Kanchenjunga is in Sikkim, but Kangchenjunga is on the border with Nepal.
problems.problem: Kanchenjunga and Kangchenjunga are the same peak; it lies on the India–Nepal border in Sikkim.
problems.correction: Kanchenjunga (Kangchenjunga) lies on the India–Nepal border in Sikkim.
problems.verifierReason: Original incorrectly treats Kanchenjunga and Kangchenjunga as two different peaks; they are alternate spellings of the same peak on the India–Nepal border in Sikkim. Correction fixes this.

problems.problem: The Inter‑State River Water Disputes Act 1956 provides for adjudication of disputes, not for project clearance. Inter‑basin links require environmental clearance, techno‑economic appraisal, and inter‑state agreements.
problems.correction: Each link requires environmental impact assessment under the Environment (Protection) Act 1986, techno‑economic appraisal by the Central Water Commission, and inter‑state agreement.
problems.verifierReason: Inter-State River Water Disputes Act 1956 is for adjudication, not project clearance. Correction correctly replaces it with inter-state agreement, retaining EIA and techno-economic appraisal requireme

problems.quote: GLIMS integrated with ISRO ’s Resourcesat‑2A and Cartosat‑3 provides near‑real‑time lake‑area alerts
problems.problem: GLIMS is a global glacier inventory database, not an operational near‑real‑time alert system; ISRO uses its own satellites for lake monitoring
problems.correction: ISRO’s Resourcesat‑2A and Cartosat‑3 provide near‑real‑time lake‑area alerts
problems.verifierReason: GLIMS is a static inventory, not an alert system; ISRO satellites do provide lake monitoring data.
